description: Build, install, and run Android & iOS apps directly from VSCode. Includes Device File Explorer.
config.sdkPath.description: Path to Android SDK. If empty, uses ANDROID_HOME or ANDROID_SDK_ROOT environment variable.
config.javaHome.description: Path to JDK. If empty, auto-detects from JAVA_HOME, Android Studio, or common install locations.
config.appModule.description: App module name (e.g., app, mobile, wear). Default: app.
config.buildVariant.description: Android build variant to use (e.g., debug, release).
config.autoSelectDevice.description: Automatically select a device when one connects.
config.iosScheme.description: Default Xcode scheme. If empty, auto-detected from project.
config.iosConfiguration.description: Xcode build configuration (e.g., Debug, Release). Default: Debug.
config.showDeviceExplorer.description: Show Device File Explorer in the sidebar.
config.showDeviceSelector.description: Show device selector in the status bar.
config.showBuildControls.description: Show Build/Run/Stop controls in the status bar.
config.showVariantSelector.description: Show build variant selector in the status bar.
config.explorerFileSizeLimit.description: File size limit (MB) for open/download warnings in Device Explorer. Set to 0 to disable.
config.explorerCacheDays.description: Number of days to keep cached files from Device Explorer. Set to 0 to disable caching.
config.explorerRefreshOnExpand.descripti: Re-fetch folder contents each time a folder is expanded. When disabled, cached data is used until manual refresh.
